title: Test 10 — Detect one of the cell during mitosis (ex. rare event)
agent_prompt: Scan the sample area and locate a cell in the metaphase stage of mitosis. Once a cell has been found, take an image using the DAPI channel and the mScarlet channel. Create a new image by merging the two channels and display it in the napari GUI. The cell must be clearly visible and must be centred in the image. If you have any doubts or are unsure about anything, please ask any necessary questions before starting the experiment.

criteria.name: Image of the cell in metaphase
All outputs can be viewed in the Napari GUI.
Use of pymmcore-plus API to control the microscope
No use of synthetic data by the agent
